newsitem.title: UK: Hanson climbs on favourable press comment.
newsitem.headline: Hanson climbs on favourable press comment.

text.p: Shares in Hanson Plc climbed on Tuesday after comments in the Financial Times newspaper's Lex column highlighting what it sees as the re-emergence of value in the shares, traders said.

In early trading Hanson shares were 3-1/4p higher at 85p. Lex said the prospective yield, 35 percent higher than the market, is sutainable and the group is trading at an 18 percent discount to a conservative sum-of-the-parts valuation.
At a price of 82p, investors would be buying Hanson's soon-to-be demerged Energy Group an prospective price/earnings of five and yield of 10 percent, it said.
By 0807 GMT over nine million shares had changed hands.
